items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I played with Sarah Vaughan and she's a good piano player. I think for a singer to really command the attention they feel that they're not getting … musicians … they sit down at the piano and show them they can play the song that they want them to play. They're gonna call my house now and say, "You said what?!" (laughs)
Let's do some lightweight stuff. Marsalis brothers.
